newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil plans to offer SOCO stock.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil plans to offer SOCO stock.

text.p: Snyder Oil Corp said Wednesday SOCO International Plc intends to seek a listing on the London Stock Exchange and conduct an initial public offering of its shares.
The offering is expected to raise about $75 million of new equity capital for SOCO, Snyder said.
Following the offering, Snyder, which will retain all its shares, expects to have a 15 to 17 percent interest in SOCO.
The assets of SOCO will consist of Snyder's interests in Mongolia, Russia and Thailand, as well as those of numerous minority interest holders in these Snyder subsidiaries.
SOCO will also acquire Cairn Energy Plc's UK onshore company as well as certain assets in Yemen and Tunisia that were formerly owned by Command Petroleum Ltd.
Ed Story, who has been responsible for Snyder's international assets since 1991, will be SOCO's chief executive officer, Snyder said.
